'''Meren Siefel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Siefel carried out a number of killings for [[Zerex]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]]. When Zerex was promoted to become the [[Moff/Legends|moff]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], he held a celebratory party in his mansion on Ord Adinorr and appointed Siefel to serve as his head of security during the event.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
